_doc: Must-check beats for the Morning Briefing. Each runs as a Google News search over the last `days` days. A must_check beat with no news in the window is sent to the scout (a targeted web search) and logged as 'checked, nothing major' if still empty. Edit freely.

beats.label: Parliament
beats.query: ("Lok Sabha" OR "Rajya Sabha" OR Parliament) bill India

beats.label: Supreme Court & High Courts
beats.query: ("Supreme Court" OR "High Court") India verdict OR order

beats.label: RBI
beats.query: RBI (repo OR "monetary policy" OR circular OR governor OR rules)

beats.label: SEBI
beats.query: SEBI (order OR rules OR circular OR IPO OR ban)

beats.label: GST & income tax
beats.query: (GST OR "income tax" OR CBDT OR "GST Council" OR ITR) India

beats.label: UPI & payments
beats.query: (UPI OR NPCI OR "credit card" OR "bank charges") India rules

beats.label: Telecom & internet
beats.query: (TRAI OR Jio OR Airtel OR "Vodafone Idea") tariff OR rules OR outage

beats.label: Fuel, LPG & prices
beats.query: ("petrol price" OR "diesel price" OR "LPG price" OR "CNG price" OR "price hike") India

beats.label: IMD weather & air
beats.query: (IMD OR cyclone OR heatwave OR "heavy rain" OR AQI OR GRAP) India alert

beats.label: Exams & jobs
beats.query: (NEET OR JEE OR UPSC OR CBSE OR SSC OR UGC) exam OR result OR date

beats.label: Rail, flights & travel
beats.query: ("Indian Railways" OR DGCA OR IndiGo OR "Air India" OR visa) India

beats.label: Economic data
beats.query: India (GDP OR inflation OR CPI OR WPI OR IIP OR PMI OR "trade deficit") data

beats.label: Elections
beats.query: ("Election Commission" OR election OR bypoll OR "chief minister") India

beats.label: Defence & security
beats.query: ("Indian Army" OR "Indian Navy" OR IAF OR DRDO OR "defence ministry" OR terror) India

beats.label: ISRO & space
beats.query: ISRO OR Gaganyaan OR Chandrayaan OR NASA OR SpaceX launch

beats.label: Health in India
beats.query: ("health ministry" OR ICMR OR dengue OR outbreak OR vaccine) India

beats.label: India's neighbours
beats.query: India (Pakistan OR China OR Bangladesh OR Nepal OR "Sri Lanka" OR Maldives) talks OR border OR tension

beats.label: Wars & ceasefires
beats.query: (ceasefire OR airstrike OR offensive OR invasion OR "peace talks")

beats.label: World elections
beats.query: election results (president OR "prime minister" OR parliament)

beats.label: Disasters
beats.query: (earthquake OR flood OR hurricane OR typhoon OR cyclone OR wildfire OR crash) killed

beats.label: Central banks
beats.query: ("Federal Reserve" OR ECB OR "Bank of Japan" OR "Bank of England" OR "People's Bank of China") rates

beats.label: Oil & commodities
beats.query: (OPEC OR "oil prices" OR Brent OR gold price)

beats.label: US–India
beats.query: (US OR Washington OR Trump) India (trade OR tariff OR visa OR H-1B)

beats.label: China
beats.query: China (Xi OR Beijing) (economy OR Taiwan OR trade OR military)

beats.label: AI companies
beats.query: (OpenAI OR Anthropic OR "Google DeepMind" OR Nvidia OR Meta) AI

beats.label: Global health
beats.query: (WHO OR outbreak OR pandemic OR Ebola OR "bird flu") health

beats.label: Climate
beats.query: (COP OR "climate summit" OR emissions OR "El Nino") climate
